svg.title: Shared reference matrix, separate cycle fits and one prepared image
svg.desc: Constructed illustration, not measured tissue data. Two aligned horizontal lanes show six registered acquired mixed-band images per cycle, followed by an independent fit of Yi approximately equals S Ai using NNLS or clipped least squares. The shared six-band by three-reference matrix S has separate columns for Alexa Fluor 555, Alexa Fluor 647 and optional autofluorescence. Its normalized sampled reference values are printed in the matrix. Both independent equations use the same compatible S without pooling cycle measurements. A shared reference connection branches to both fits. Each of the six acquired bands is visible and labeled B1 through B6. Colour-linked dye-to-marker assignments identify CD8/CD3 in cycle 1 and CD4/CD20 in cycle 2. A cycle-by-fluorophore assignment grid shares full Alexa Fluor 555 and Alexa Fluor 647 column headers across both cycle rows. Matching short dye labels and colours link the grid to the reference and recovered-channel columns. The two recovered rows join through short local connectors into one explicit six-plane channel stack at the right. Every assembled plane preserves the corresponding recovered field, marker and cycle identity. The stack is an exploded view of co-registered XY planes, not a projection or pooled intensity. A compatible autofluorescence reference may be shared, while AF1 and AF2 are fitted independently. The synthetic component images use identical spatial coordinates and fixed display scales across cycles: zero to three for dye channels and zero to 0.7 for AF; mixed bands use zero to 1.55. Every mixed field is computed as Y equals S A. Colours encode spectral components, not cell phenotype probabilities.
